subject: Quick 20m intro — coordinating NZST <> PDT windows
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Darius O'Keefe <darius.okeefe@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick 20m intro — coordinating NZST <> PDT windows

Hi Darius —

Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer role at Redwood. I reviewed your resume (attached) and would love to do a 20-minute intro to hear more about your recent infra work and share a quick overview of the role and next steps.

I know time zones can be rough — I'm on Pacific time (PDT). Here are a few 20-minute slots that work on my end (all PDT):
- Fri Jul 19, 9:00–9:20 AM PDT (Sat Jul 20, 4:00–4:20 AM NZST)
- Fri Jul 19, 4:00–4:20 PM PDT (Sat Jul 20, 1:00–1:20 AM NZST)
- Sat Jul 20, 7:00–7:20 AM PDT (Sat Jul 20, 2:00–2:20 AM NZST)

If none of those are workable, can you propose two 20-minute windows in your local time (please include TZ) and I'll convert on my side and loop in the hiring manager. I've attached your resume I pulled from the application for quick reference and included a small ICS stub for easy add.

Options are flexible — we can do early mornings PDT (which will be evening NZST) or late afternoons PDT (which are early morning NZST). Let me know what suits you and whether you prefer phone or Google Meet.

Cheers,
Sooj
Soojín Lee (she/her)
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Darius_OKeefe_Resume.pdf

From: Darius O'Keefe <darius.okeefe@gmail.com>

Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 20:23:00 +12:00
Subject: Re: Quick 20m intro — coordinating NZST <> PDT windows

Hi Sooj —

Thanks for the quick note and for reviewing my application. I’m actually based in Wellington, NZ (NZST, UTC+12). The slots you proposed are in the middle of the night here. I can do early evenings NZST (which I think maps to late mornings/early afternoons PDT). Two options that work on my side:

- Sat Jul 20, 18:00–18:20 NZST (Sat Jul 20, 06:00–06:20 PDT)
- Sun Jul 21, 19:30–19:50 NZST (Sun Jul 21, 07:30–07:50 PDT)

I’m fine with Google Meet — I’ll accept whichever you pick. I attached a tiny .ics showing these preferred slots for convenience.

Best,
Darius

Attachments: darius_preferred_slots.ics

Thanks for the quick reply, Darius — really appreciate the clarity on NZST. Rishi (hiring manager) is cc'd so he can join if available.

I converted your two suggested slots to PDT and the first one works best for Rishi and me:

- Sat Jul 20, 18:00 NZST = Fri Jul 19, 06:00 PDT (20-minute intro)

This is an early start on our side but doable — I can take that slot. If that exact time is still good for you, I’ll send a calendar invite (Google Meet link) and include a short agenda: 1) 10 min candidate background, 2) 8–10 min role Q&A, 3) next steps.

If you prefer the later slot (Sun Jul 21, 19:30 NZST = Sun Jul 21, 07:30 PDT) we can do that instead — please confirm. I attached the invite ICS (redwood_intro_invite.ics) — it’ll say Fri Jul 19 06:00 PDT / Sat Jul 20 18:00 NZST in the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Warmly,
Sooj
